title: The Market Shock
tagline: A fictional market falls 9% in a day. Everyone has an opinion.

character.name: Sunita
character.role: teacher saving for her child's education in 8 years (fictional)

m1_shock.title: A very bad day
m1_shock.narrative: In this fictional world the BharatFictio 100 index falls 9% in one day. Sunita's simulated ₹1,00,000 in the fictional 'Sample Growth Basket' now shows ₹91,000. Her goal — her child's education — is 8 years away. This describes a fictional situation; nobody here is told what to buy or sell.

messages: MARKET CRASH: Index down 9% in a single session.
Friend Anil: Sell everything NOW before it goes to zero!!
Colleague Bhavna: Great discount! Put in more right now!

pressure.text: Two people give opposite urgent orders.
The trading window closes in a few minutes today.

evidence.label: Down 9% in one day
evidence.text: A large one-day drop in this fictional market.
evidence.why: A big fall is uncomfortable and real, but one day does not tell you what comes next.

evidence.label: Her goal is 8 years away
evidence.text: Sunita does not need this money tomorrow.
evidence.why: Time horizon and needs matter more to a decision than one day's headline.

evidence.label: “Sell NOW before it goes to zero!!”
evidence.text: A fear-driven order with no reasoning.
evidence.why: Nobody can know whether prices will keep falling or recover. Certainty in either direction is a signal to slow down.

evidence.label: “Great discount! Put in more now!”
evidence.text: A greed-driven order with no reasoning.
evidence.why: Both messages create urgency. Neither knows the future. Urgency in both directions is the same pressure.

evidence.label: Nobody can say what happens next
evidence.text: No credible source can promise recovery or further falls.
evidence.why: Accepting uncertainty is part of making sound decisions in markets.

actions.label: Sell everything right now — I can't stand watching this
actions.consequence: You act under pressure. The relief is immediate; the loss is now fixed at ₹9,000 (simulated).

actions.label: Put in more money right now to win the loss back fast
actions.consequence: You act on a hope of quick recovery. Your simulated exposure doubles at an uncertain moment.

actions.label: Pause: write down my goal, time horizon and how much loss I can handle, then decide
actions.consequence: You switch off the news and write three lines. The decision feels quieter.

actions.label: Check prices every hour and decide tonight
actions.consequence: Each refresh brings a new feeling. By evening you are exhausted and less clear.

actions.label: Talk to someone I trust or a registered professional before acting
actions.consequence: You ask for help thinking, not for a prediction.

m1_shock.reasoning_prompt: What is driving your choice right now?

m2_after.title: Two fictional weeks later
m2_after.narrative: In this fictional fortnight the index rises 4% on Monday and falls 5% on Wednesday. Anil texts: “Told you so!” No path is a prediction; it is a story to practise on.

messages: Told you so! Do what I say next time.
Now it's time to sell/buy again — switch quickly!

evidence.label: “Told you so” is hindsight
evidence.text: It was not knowable then; it feels obvious now.
evidence.why: Hindsight makes outcomes seem predictable. A person who was right once may simply have been lucky.

evidence.label: Daily swings of ±5% this fortnight
evidence.text: The path has been bumpy both ways.
evidence.why: This is volatility: large swings in both directions are part of how such assets behave.

evidence.label: “Switch quickly!” — each switch has costs and needs a correct guess
evidence.text: Moving in and out repeatedly adds costs and requires timing the unknowable.
evidence.why: Reacting to every headline is a pattern that tends to turn temporary swings into real, repeated costs.

actions.label: Re-read my plan; act only if my goal, time or needs have changed
actions.consequence: The plan holds — your goal and needs have not changed — and you stay calm.

actions.label: Do what Anil says — he called it right
actions.consequence: You hand your decision to someone whose track record you cannot verify.

actions.label: Buy or sell each time the news changes
actions.consequence: Every headline becomes a trigger. The simulated costs and stress pile up.

actions.label: Ask a trusted person or registered professional to review my plan with me
actions.consequence: You ask for a second pair of eyes on your plan, not a prediction.

m2_after.reasoning_prompt: How do you decide whom or what to listen to?

t_calm.title: You decided by your plan
t_calm.narrative: You separated the noise from your actual goals. A plan written when calm is a tool for when you are not. Nobody can predict the market; you can prepare your own response.

outcome.headline: You decided by your plan
outcome.summary: You separated the noise from your actual goals. A plan written when calm is a tool for when you are not. Nobody can predict the market; you can prepare your own response.

t_support.title: You used support wisely
t_support.narrative: Asking for a second view on your plan — not a prediction — is a mature use of help. Check anyone's registration on the official site yourself before relying on them.

outcome.headline: You used support wisely
outcome.summary: Asking for a second view on your plan — not a prediction — is a mature use of help. Check anyone's registration on the official site yourself before relying on them.

t_hindsight.title: Following the loudest voice
t_hindsight.narrative: A person who was right once may have been lucky; hindsight makes luck look like skill. Handing your decisions to a voice you cannot verify is the same risk as any unverified tip.

outcome.headline: Following the loudest voice
outcome.summary: A person who was right once may have been lucky; hindsight makes luck look like skill. Handing your decisions to a voice you cannot verify is the same risk as any unverified tip.

t_churn.title: Reacting to every headline
t_churn.narrative: Switching with every headline adds costs and needs repeated correct guesses about the unknowable. Calm, written rules protect you from your own reactions.

outcome.headline: Reacting to every headline
outcome.summary: Switching with every headline adds costs and needs repeated correct guesses about the unknowable. Calm, written rules protect you from your own reactions.

key_points: Volatility means big moves in both directions. A big drop is uncomfortable, but one day does not tell you what comes next.
Fear and greed give the same kind of urgent orders. Both are pressure, not information.
Nobody can predict the market. You can prepare your own response in advance.
A friend who was right once is not proof of skill.
questions: What would be in your own written plan?

micro_lesson.title: Prepare your response before the storm
micro_lesson.body: Write down three things when you are calm: your goal, your time horizon, and what size of fall you can handle without panic. Use them to check headlines, not the other way round.

hinglish.title: The Market Shock (Bazaar mein Bhookamp)
hinglish.tagline: Ek kaalpanik bazaar ek din mein 9% girta hai. Sab ke paas raay hai.
hinglish.states.m1_shock.title: Ek bahut kharab din
hinglish.states.m1_shock.narrative: Is kaalpanik duniya mein BharatFictio 100 index ek din mein 9% gir jaata hai. Sunita ke simulated ₹1,00,000 jo kaalpanik 'Sample Growth Basket' mein hain ab ₹91,000 dikhate hain. Uska goal — bachche ki padhai — 8 saal door hai. Ye ek kaalpanik sthiti hai; yahan kisi ko kuch kharidne ya bechne ko nahi kaha jaata.
hinglish.states.m1_shock.channel.messages.0: MARKET CRASH: Ek hi session mein index 9% neeche.
hinglish.states.m1_shock.channel.messages.1: Dost Anil: Abhi SAB bech do, warna zero ho jayega!!
hinglish.states.m1_shock.channel.messages.2: Colleague Bhavna: Zabardast discount! Abhi aur paisa daalo!
hinglish.states.m1_shock.pressure.1.text: Do log ulte, jaldi ke hukm dete hain.
hinglish.states.m1_shock.pressure.2.text: Aaj trading window kuch minutes mein band hoti hai.
hinglish.states.m1_shock.evidence.ms_move.label: Ek din mein 9% neeche
hinglish.states.m1_shock.evidence.ms_move.text: Is kaalpanik market mein ek din ki badi giravat.
hinglish.states.m1_shock.evidence.ms_move.why: Badi giravat takleefdeh aur asli hai, par ek din se agla kuch nahi pata chalta.
hinglish.states.m1_shock.evidence.ms_goal.label: Uska goal 8 saal door hai
hinglish.states.m1_shock.evidence.ms_goal.text: Sunita ko ye paisa kal nahi chahiye.
hinglish.states.m1_shock.evidence.ms_goal.why: Faisle ke liye time horizon aur zaroorat ek din ki headline se zyada maayne rakhti hain.
hinglish.states.m1_shock.evidence.ms_panic.label: “Abhi bech do, zero ho jayega!!”
hinglish.states.m1_shock.evidence.ms_panic.text: Bina tark ke darr se bhara hukm.
hinglish.states.m1_shock.evidence.ms_panic.why: Koi nahi jaanta ki daam girte rahenge ya sudhrenge. Kisi bhi disha mein pakka vishwas dhimaa hone ka sanket hai.
hinglish.states.m1_shock.evidence.ms_dip.label: “Zabardast discount! Abhi aur daalo!”
hinglish.states.m1_shock.evidence.ms_dip.text: Bina tark ke laalach se bhara hukm.
hinglish.states.m1_shock.evidence.ms_dip.why: Dono messages jaldi banate hain. Koi bhavishya nahi jaanta. Dono taraf ki jaldi ek hi dabaav hai.
hinglish.states.m1_shock.evidence.ms_unknown.labe: Aage kya hoga koi nahi bata sakta
hinglish.states.m1_shock.evidence.ms_unknown.text: Koi vishwasniya source na sudhaar ka vaada kar sakta hai na aur girne ka.
hinglish.states.m1_shock.evidence.ms_unknown.why: Anishchitta ko maanna bazaar mein sahi faisle ka hissa hai.
hinglish.states.m1_shock.actions.sell_all.label: Abhi sab bech do — ye dekha nahi jaata
hinglish.states.m1_shock.actions.sell_all.consequ: Aap dabaav mein kaam karte ho. Rahat turant milti hai; nuksaan ab ₹9,000 (simulated) par tay ho gaya.
hinglish.states.m1_shock.actions.add_more.label: Nuksaan jaldi wapas paane ke liye abhi aur paisa daalo
hinglish.states.m1_shock.actions.add_more.consequ: Aap jaldi sudhaar ki ummeed par kaam karte ho. Anishchit samay par aapka simulated exposure doguna ho jaata hai.
hinglish.states.m1_shock.actions.pause_plan.label: Ruko: apna goal, samay-seema aur kitna nuksaan jhel sakti hoon likho, phir faisla karo
hinglish.states.m1_shock.actions.pause_plan.conse: Aap news band karke teen line likhti ho. Faisla shaant lagta hai.
hinglish.states.m1_shock.actions.watch_hourly.lab: Har ghante daam dekho aur raat ko faisla karo
hinglish.states.m1_shock.actions.watch_hourly.con: Har refresh par naya ehsaas. Shaam tak aap thak jaati ho aur kam saaf soch paati ho.
hinglish.states.m1_shock.actions.ask_trusted.labe: Kuch karne se pehle kisi bharosemand ya registered professional se baat karo
hinglish.states.m1_shock.actions.ask_trusted.cons: Aap sochne mein madad maangti ho, bhavishyavani nahi.
hinglish.states.m1_shock.reasoning_prompt: Abhi aapke faisle ko kya chala raha hai?
hinglish.states.m2_after.title: Do kaalpanik hafte baad
hinglish.states.m2_after.narrative: Is kaalpanik pakhwade mein index Monday ko 4% badhta hai aur Wednesday ko 5% girta hai. Anil likhta hai: “Maine kaha tha!” Koi raasta bhavishyavani nahi; ye abhyas ki kahani hai.
hinglish.states.m2_after.channel.messages.0: Maine kaha tha! Agli baar meri baat maanna.
hinglish.states.m2_after.channel.messages.1: Ab phir bechne/kharidne ka time hai — jaldi badlo!
hinglish.states.m2_after.pressure.0.text: Anil kehta hai use pata tha.
hinglish.states.m2_after.evidence.m2_hind.label: “Maine kaha tha” pichhli nazar hai
hinglish.states.m2_after.evidence.m2_hind.text: Tab pata nahi tha; ab saaf lagta hai.
hinglish.states.m2_after.evidence.m2_hind.why: Pichhli nazar se nateeje purvanumey lagte hain. Ek baar sahi hone wala bas kismatwala bhi ho sakta hai.
hinglish.states.m2_after.evidence.m2_swing.label: Is pakhwade mein roz ±5% ka utaar-chadhav
hinglish.states.m2_after.evidence.m2_swing.why: Ye volatility hai: dono taraf badi halchal aise assets ka swabhav hai.
hinglish.states.m2_after.evidence.m2_switch.label: “Jaldi badlo!” — har badlaav mein kharcha aur sahi anuman chahiye
hinglish.states.m2_after.evidence.m2_switch.text: Baar-baar andar-bahar karne se kharcha badhta hai aur anishchit ka sahi samay pakadna padta hai.
hinglish.states.m2_after.evidence.m2_switch.why: Har headline par pratikriya dena aksar asthayi utaar-chadhav ko asli, baar-baar ke kharche mein badal deta hai.
hinglish.states.m2_after.actions.stick_plan.label: Apna plan dobara padho; tabhi kuch karo jab goal, samay ya zaroorat badli ho
hinglish.states.m2_after.actions.stick_plan.conse: Plan tika hai — goal aur zaroorat nahi badli — aur aap shaant rehti ho.
hinglish.states.m2_after.actions.follow_anil.labe: Anil jo kahe wahi karo — usne sahi pakda
hinglish.states.m2_after.actions.follow_anil.cons: Aap apna faisla aise insaan ko de dete ho jiska track record aap check nahi kar sakte.
hinglish.states.m2_after.actions.react_news.label: Jab bhi khabar badle tab kharido ya becho
hinglish.states.m2_after.actions.react_news.conse: Har headline trigger ban jaati hai. Simulated kharche aur tanav badhte jaate hain.
hinglish.states.m2_after.actions.ask_review.label: Kisi bharosemand ya registered professional se mera plan review karwao
hinglish.states.m2_after.actions.ask_review.conse: Aap apne plan par doosri nazar maangti ho, bhavishyavani nahi.
hinglish.states.m2_after.reasoning_prompt: Aap kaise tay karti ho ki kisko ya kya sunna hai?
hinglish.states.t_calm.title: Aapne apne plan se faisla kiya
hinglish.states.t_calm.narrative: Aapne shor ko apne asli goals se alag kiya. Shaanti mein likha plan tab kaam aata hai jab aap shaant nahi hote. Market koi predict nahi kar sakta; aap apni pratikriya taiyar kar sakte ho.
hinglish.states.t_calm.outcome.headline: Aapne apne plan se faisla kiya
hinglish.states.t_calm.outcome.summary: Aapne shor ko apne asli goals se alag kiya. Shaanti mein likha plan tab kaam aata hai jab aap shaant nahi hote. Market koi predict nahi kar sakta; aap apni pratikriya taiyar kar sakte ho.
hinglish.states.t_support.title: Aapne madad samajhdari se li
hinglish.states.t_support.narrative: Plan par doosri raay maangna — bhavishyavani nahi — madad ka samajhdaar tareeka hai. Kisi par bharosa karne se pehle uska registration official site par khud check karo.
hinglish.states.t_support.outcome.headline: Aapne madad samajhdari se li
hinglish.states.t_support.outcome.summary: Plan par doosri raay maangna — bhavishyavani nahi — madad ka samajhdaar tareeka hai. Kisi par bharosa karne se pehle uska registration official site par khud check karo.
hinglish.states.t_hindsight.title: Sabse tez awaaz ke peeche
hinglish.states.t_hindsight.narrative: Ek baar sahi hone wala kismatwala ho sakta hai; pichhli nazar kismat ko hunar dikhati hai. Apne faisle aise awaaz ko dena jise verify na kar sako, kisi bhi unverified tip jaisa hi risk hai.
hinglish.states.t_hindsight.outcome.headline: Sabse tez awaaz ke peeche
hinglish.states.t_hindsight.outcome.summary: Ek baar sahi hone wala kismatwala ho sakta hai; pichhli nazar kismat ko hunar dikhati hai. Apne faisle aise awaaz ko dena jise verify na kar sako, kisi bhi unverified tip jaisa hi risk hai.
hinglish.states.t_churn.title: Har headline par pratikriya
hinglish.states.t_churn.narrative: Har headline par badalne se kharcha badhta hai aur anishchit ke baare mein baar-baar sahi anuman lagana padta hai. Shaant, likhe hue niyam aapko apni hi pratikriya se bachate hain.
hinglish.states.t_churn.outcome.headline: Har headline par pratikriya
hinglish.states.t_churn.outcome.summary: Har headline par badalne se kharcha badhta hai aur anishchit ke baare mein baar-baar sahi anuman lagana padta hai. Shaant, likhe hue niyam aapko apni hi pratikriya se bachate hain.
hinglish.reflection.key_points.0: Volatility ka matlab dono taraf badi halchal. Badi giravat takleefdeh hai par ek din aage ka nahi batata.
hinglish.reflection.key_points.1: Darr aur laalach ek jaise jaldi ke hukm dete hain. Dono dabaav hain, jaankari nahi.
hinglish.reflection.key_points.2: Market koi predict nahi kar sakta. Aap apni pratikriya pehle se taiyar kar sakte ho.
hinglish.reflection.key_points.3: Ek baar sahi hone wala dost hunar ka saboot nahi.
hinglish.reflection.questions.0: Aapke likhe plan mein kya hota?
hinglish.reflection.micro_lesson.title: Toofan se pehle apni pratikriya taiyar karo
hinglish.reflection.micro_lesson.body: Shaanti mein teen cheezein likho: aapka goal, samay-seema, aur kitni giravat bina ghabraye jhel sakte ho. Headlines ko inse check karo, ulta nahi.
